name: KEYS Research Internship 2027
what_you_do: Do a 7 week research project in a University of Arizona science lab. A scientist is your mentor. Earn 3 units of college credit.
who_can_apply: Currently in high school, 16 or older by June 7, 2027, a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, and lived in Arizona at least one year.
pay_detail: No cost to participate. A stipend is not mentioned. Earns 3 units of MCB credit.
deadline_text: Applications are open Nov 2 to Dec 17, 2026. Recommendations are due Jan 7.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. It has 3 essay questions. Add 2 recommenders. One must be a science teacher. They fill out an online form by Jan 7; letters are not accepted. Add an unofficial transcript and a resume.
notes: Both recommendations must be in by Jan 7. If not, your form will not be looked at.
